# Younoya

> Intentional gifting and considered keepsakes inspired by astrology. Younoya helps visitors explore meaningful objects for people, occasions and new beginnings.

## Explore

- [The boutique story](https://younoya.com/): a scroll-led visit to Younoya.
- [The collection](https://younoya.com/shop): eight keepsakes with product details and displayed prices.
- [Let Younoya choose](https://younoya.com/find-a-gift): an interactive, local gift-selection preview. The current preview is not a full Vedic astrology or AI reading.

## Notes

Product pages describe each object’s displayed price, materials, intentions and care. Prices and availability should be confirmed on the storefront before purchasing.
